description: 4 Orang 0 Solusi is a team of four from Indonesia combining storytelling, web development, and playtesting to make space exploration fun and accessible for children. Through Don’t Call Us Space Trash!, we bring the stories of NASA’s forgotten explorers to life.
summary:
Don’t Call Us Space Trash! is a web-based interactive story that introduces elementary-grade learners to NASA hardware left on the Moon and Mars, with a visit to Dawn in the asteroid belt. Told through the imagined voices of the machines themselves, the story combines illustrated scenes and interactions with real mission events.

Learners discover what the hardware helped scientists explore, why missions end, and why equipment is sometimes left behind or placed in a carefully chosen orbit. By connecting space history with engineering decisions and planetary protection, the project encourages children to value past exploration and think about our responsibility toward other worlds.
